backend/main.mo: Motoko actor that stores per-user domain scan results (subdomains, WHOIS, DNS, SSL, HTTP headers) in a nested map, with functions to save scans, retrieve scan history, and fetch individual scan results.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report JSON file with no features listed.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a reference index for the project's frontend components and services.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, covering background, foreground, card, sidebar, chart, and destructive color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point that mounts the React app into a root div and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that composes the sticky header, domain scan form, scan results panel, scan history sidebar, and footer into the main application layout.
frontend/src/components/DnsRecordsSectio: Displays DNS records grouped by type in a color-coded scrollable table with type-count badges for each record category.
frontend/src/components/DomainScanForm.t: Domain input form component that validates input, orchestrates a full reconnaissance scan via reconApi, saves results to the backend, and reports scan status to the parent.
frontend/src/components/HostingSection.t: Displays hosting and geolocation details (IP, hostname, org, ASN, city, region, country, timezone, coordinates) in a two-column grid of labeled info rows.
frontend/src/components/HttpHeadersSecti: Displays HTTP response headers with a security summary panel showing counts of present vs. missing security headers, and a scrollable list that color-codes headers as security-relevant, sensitive, or neutral.
frontend/src/components/ScanHistory.tsx: Renders a sidebar panel of past domain scans fetched from the backend, allowing users to select a previous scan to reload its recon data or refresh the history list.
frontend/src/components/ScanResults.tsx: Displays full recon results for a scanned domain using a tabbed layout (Subdomains, Hosting, WHOIS, DNS, SSL, Headers), delegating each tab's content to a dedicated section component.
frontend/src/components/SslCertificateSe: Shows SSL certificate details (common name, issuer, validity dates, SANs) with visual warnings for expired or soon-to-expire certificates.
frontend/src/components/SubdomainsSectio: Lists discovered subdomains with optional IP addresses in a scrollable view and provides a copy-all button to export results to the clipboard.
frontend/src/components/WhoisSection.tsx: Renders parsed WHOIS data fields (registrar, registrant, dates, name servers) in a grid layout with an optional toggle to view the raw WHOIS text.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider context and useInternetIdentity hook for managing ICP Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching scan history, fetching a single scan by domain, and saving a new scan to the ICP backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet importing JetBrains Mono/Inter fonts and Tailwind, defining CSS custom properties for a dark cyber/terminal theme with neon green and cyan tokens.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/services/reconApi.ts: Frontend service module that performs domain reconnaissance by calling public APIs (crt.sh, HackerTarget, ipapi.co, etc.) to gather subdomains, hosting info, WHOIS, DNS records, SSL cert details, and HTTP headers.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom cyber color tokens (neon green/cyan, surfaces), oklch-based semantic color variables, custom fonts, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata file tracking a single pending feature request to publish the Web Recon & Security Info Tool to ICP mainnet production.
